observations.title: Sabancaya volcano (Peru)
observations.description: The Instituto Geofísico del Perú?s (IGP) Centro Vulcanológico Nacional (CENVUL) reported continuing eruptive activity at Sabancaya during 14-20 September. The seismic network detected 63 seismic events associated with the movement of magmatic fluids, along with earthquakes indicating internal rock fracturing; no volcanic explosions occurred during the period. Gas, steam, and ash emissions periodically rose as high as 1.7 km above the summit and drifted less than 10 km SE. Moderate sulfur dioxide (SO?) emissions averaged 937 tons per day, and 13 thermal anomalies (each 4 MW or less) associated with the lava dome were identified. The Alert Level remained at Orange (the third level on a four-color scale) and the public was warned to stay outside of a 12 km radius from the summit. Source: Instituto Geofísico del Perú (IGP)
